fluff.overview: Johnston Industries, one of the Federated Suns' largest military manufacturers, relies on Rapid Response Forces as its first line of reinforcement for factory security. Riding small, lightly armored hover bikes, RRF troopers combine speed with dismounted flexibility, able to cover the sprawling factory complexes that span dozens of kilometers across worlds like New Syrtis and Benet III. Armed with assault rifles and infantry LRM launchers, these platoons can respond to incursions faster than conventional garrison troops while delivering both direct and indirect fire support. The hover bikes trade protection for mobility, leaving troopers vulnerable if forced into sustained engagements, but Johnston's security doctrine emphasizes rapid reinforcement over static defense.
